critical_code_review_comments: _KYC_PRIVATE_FIELDS correctly strips id_front_path/id_back_path/notes/verifier/timestamps from public /professionals/{id} responses while still allowing id_verified boolean. Verified empirically.
POST /api/admin/kyc/{user_id}/verify correctly enforces both-sides-required (returns 400 when a user has no uploads) and admin-only (403 for clients).
GET /api/files/kyc/{path} has correct access control: 200 owner, 200 admin, 403 other authenticated user, 401/403 unauthenticated.
Image-only validation works for PDF (.pdf), text (.txt), and >8MB payloads (all 400).
Re-uploading either side resets id_verified=false & status=pending (admin verify approve->reject flow proves this state machine works).
